{{Quote|Don't cause any trouble in Javyar's Cantina. You leave your problems and your attitude at the door.|translated=1|The bouncer, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and copper-colored skin worked as a '''bouncer''' during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. They wore a yellow and white [[Flight suit/Legends|suit]] and wielded a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]]. The Rodian understood spoken [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and spoke [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', in which the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] appears, in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> they worked at [[Javyar's Cantina]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Lower City]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. They guarded the establishment's door and repeated its rule about leaving problems at the door to entering patrons. Following the quarantine of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] was told by Sith [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanders]] to not allow on duty [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith soldiers]] into the cantina. The Rodian would refuse entry to [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] still in their [[Sith trooper armor/Legends|armor]], knowing some had attempted to sneak in.<ref name="KOTOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The bouncer was approached by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], a former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] with the memories of a [[Republic soldier]]. They told Revan the cantina's rule and let<ref name="KOTOR" /> him<ref name="Campaign guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> into the cantina.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Hold on. The Sith commanders have said I can't let any of you troopers into the cantina while you're on duty.|translated=1|The bouncer, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The bouncer appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. Interactions with the bouncer are optional and have no effect on plot, quests, or alignment. If the player speaks to the bouncer or attempts to enter Javyar's Cantina while wearing Sith [[Armor/Legends|armor]], they will stop the player and inform them of the Sith commanders' instructions. The player may tell the Rodian that they are not currently on duty, but they will still refuse entry, claiming that Revan is not the first soldier to attempt to sneak in while on-duty.<ref name="KOTOR" />
